## 8. Gaps / ambiguities (scenarios & edge cases)

**Missing or thin API scenarios**

- **Field updates on terminal tickets:** May PATCH `title` / add **comment** on `CLOSED` / `CANCELLED`? Not specified (only status transitions are exhaustive).  
- **Comment on any status:** Allowed on `CANCELLED`? Implied yes (no rule forbids).  
- **Ask `question` max length:** **Open** in `rag-api-contract.md`; `api-contract.md` has trim/blank only.  
- **Malformed JSON / wrong Content-Type:** Implied by Spring defaults; not in AC tables.  
- **Concurrent PATCH** (two clients change status): No optimistic locking / **409** story — **not specified**.  
- **Ingest failure** after successful ticket write: Ticket saved, index stale — no compensating action / user-visible error.  
- **LLM / Ollama down:** 5xx expected; no contract detail for partial retrieval success.  
- **Invalid `category` / `priority` on PATCH:** Partially covered; invalid **sort** field — check `api-contract.md` (some list params documented).  
- **PATCH `status` + invalid non-status field:** Whole request fails — `state-machine.md` §6.4; worth one **AC-API** negative example in `api-contract.md`.  
- **Self-transition 409** when client sends current status: Documented in SM §6.1.1; easy to miss in UI (disable current status in dropdown).  
- **Empty description ticket ingest:** `data-model.md` **Proposed** zero chunks vs minimal chunk — `rag-ingestion.md` should own single rule.  
- **Metadata-only re-ingest** on status change: `rag-ingestion.md` §10 **Proposed** — good; failure if ingest skipped would break AC-FEAT-14-03.  
- **Eval Q4 “similar resolved”:** `evaluation-strategy.md` §5.2 — **Open**; demo may be subjective.  
- **High-priority payment Q5:** Metadata pre-filter **Open** (`architecture.md` §15.5) — retrieval may need text match only.

**Process / registry**

- **DEC-14** “Interim agreed” vs hub line 7 listing it among still-open DECs.  
- **DEC-02** “confirmed 2026-10-04” in `state-machine.md` revision vs **Open** in §10.2 — intentional interim, but confusing for implementers.
